name: criminal
description: Humanoid enemies, outlaws, and criminal specialists

entries.value: Roadside Bandit — an underpaid ambusher demanding supplies rather than bloodshed.
Dockside Smuggler — a sailor moving contraband inside sealed fish barrels.
Cutpurse — a quick urban thief working crowded markets and religious festivals.
Protection Racketeer — an enforcer collecting payments for dangers their gang secretly creates.
Poacher — a skilled tracker hunting protected animals for wealthy buyers.
Grave Robber — a desperate excavator selling jewelry, bones, and buried secrets.
Highway Impostor — a criminal wearing a stolen uniform to levy false tolls.
Fence — a respectable shopkeeper specializing in making stolen goods appear legitimate.
Counterfeiter — an artisan producing false coins, seals, travel papers, and noble letters.
Blackmailer — an information broker using real secrets and carefully manufactured evidence.
Kidnapper — a patient planner targeting people whose families cannot involve authorities.
Illegal Duelist — a professional fighter paid to injure rivals under improvised rules.
Relic Thief — a specialist stealing sacred or magical objects without understanding them.
Arsonist — a saboteur using delayed alchemical fires to destroy records and businesses.
Corrupt Bailiff — an official abusing legal authority to seize property and silence witnesses.
Pirate Boarding Chief — a disciplined raider seeking cargo and ransom instead of sinking ships.
Gang Alchemist — a brewer of addictive tonics, smoke bombs, and unreliable combat stimulants.
Assassin — a meticulous killer arranging deaths to resemble accidents or divine punishment.
Crime Mage — an outlaw using subtle magic to bypass locks, witnesses, and contracts.
Slave Trader — a guarded trafficker protected by forged laws and complicit officials.
Bandit Prince — a charismatic warlord uniting scattered gangs into a territorial army.
False Prophet — a cult leader engineering miracles to gain wealth and political immunity.
Royal Forger — a master criminal capable of manufacturing convincing claims to titles and land.
Underworld Judge — a feared mediator whose private court settles disputes between criminal factions.
